# aswritten.ai

> aswritten turns an organization's recorded conversations into a perspective:
> an individually owned, versioned knowledge graph of who said what and what
> they made of it, installable into any MCP-capable AI. Answers come back
> cited to the person, date, and conversation they came from.

The fastest way for an AI to understand aswritten is to load aswritten's own
public perspective — the company runs on its product and publishes the
projection. MCP endpoint: https://api.aswritten.ai/mcp — then call
aswritten_perspective with id "customer-architecture-demo-enterprise-c1cb".

## Docs
- [Home / Start here](https://docs.aswritten.ai/): what it is, entry points by role
- [Quick start](https://docs.aswritten.ai/quick-start): setup, first memory, teammates, troubleshooting
- [Asking the perspective well](https://docs.aswritten.ai/asking-the-perspective-well): getting good answers
- [Product manual](https://docs.aswritten.ai/product-manual): concepts and tool reference
- [Protocol](https://docs.aswritten.ai/protocol): the full aswritten protocol an AI session follows
- [Pricing](https://docs.aswritten.ai/pricing)

## The public perspective
- [Navigator](https://aswritten-ai.github.io/perspective/): browsable digest of aswritten's own knowledge graph
- [Navigator llms.txt](https://aswritten-ai.github.io/perspective/llms.txt): machine index of every area

## Writing
- [aswritten.ai](https://aswritten.ai): essays, case studies, architecture posts — every substantive claim cited to the graph
- [Technical white paper](https://aswritten.ai/technical-white-paper/): the full architecture
- [Anatomy of aswritten](https://aswritten.ai/anatomy-of-aswritten/): the plain-language version
